description: Mirror-state model for the rust-primary campaign (#539 rust-primary-mirror-state). One entry per tool: the primary edition, the other edition's state, and the parity check that enforces parity when the mirror state is parity. The engine resolver (common/bin/engine-resolver) reads the generated validation/editions.tsv (one tab-separated line per tool, regenerated by scripts/check_editions.py --write-tsv and checked against this file on every validation run) and refuses an explicit request for a paused, archived, or absent mirror; scripts/check_editions.py proves this file matches the tracked entrypoints and the Rust agentctl python-only subcommand lists. Mirror states: parity (kept in lockstep by the named parity check), paused (mirror frozen; paused_at names the commit), archived (mirror retained read-only, no catch-up planned), absent (no such edition).

tools.name: agentctl
tools.note: Rust is primary since the engine-rust-default switch. The subcommands below are the exceptions: they are python-primary with no Rust edition yet, and the Rust edition refuses them by name (rs/agentctl/src/cli.rs PYTHON_ONLY_COMMANDS and PYTHON_ONLY_CHAT_COMMANDS). Fleshing them out is campaign milestone 2: chat history and chat context (adapter transports) moved to Rust in #545 rust-primary-agentctl-chat-readers; chat launch is next.

subcommands.name: migrate
subcommands.note: Headless-worker migration; stays python-primary until the herdr-subagents port carries it (coordinator decision, #545).

subcommands.name: repair
subcommands.note: Headless-worker operation; stays python-primary until the herdr-subagents port carries it (coordinator decision, #545).

subcommands.name: chat launch
subcommands.note: Google Chat polling launcher; blocks retiring Python agentctl.

tools.name: herdr-chat
tools.note: Standalone chat-bridge entrypoint (agentctl.chat). The Rust agentctl chat subcommand covers run/status/reply/close but not launch/history/context; see the agentctl subcommands.

tools.name: herdr-subagents
tools.note: Headless foreign-harness workers; the Rust agentctl refuses headless workers with a pointer to this Python edition.

tools.name: parallel-experiment-runner
tools.note: Python-only; last in the campaign port order (milestone 5).

tools.name: wrkslots
tools.note: Python-only CLI. rs/wrkslotsd is a separate read-only observer/index CLI (not a daemon and not a wrkslots edition); the campaign grows it into the Rust edition subcommand by subcommand (milestone 4).

tools.name: wrkslotsd
tools.note: Rust observer/CLI growing into the wrkslots Rust edition (#562 rust-primary-wrkslots); today it replays EVENTS logs and parses .wrkslots.yml documents (parse-config) at parity with the Python loader.

tools.name: wrkviz
tools.note: Python-only; its static site assets carry over to any Rust edition. Port follows wrkslots (milestone 5), after building a test corpus.

tools.name: agent-teams
tools.note: Rust-only crate (rs/agent-teams); no tracked bin symlink and no Python edition. Listed so the inventory is complete.
